verdicts.reason: In both, the robot vacuum is cropped until it is just an unrecognisable dark sliver. The purple circle has shrunk to an odd quarter-blob stuck on the left that no longer holds the text. The headline now sits straight on a dark, busy wood photo, and the dot grid sits loose in the middle. A at least leaves a clear gap between the small two-line 'Smart Home' and 'GADGETS'. B jams 'Smart Home' right up against 'GADGETS', so the lockup looks cramped and accidental.
